preship_review.A_physics_geography: Gross tonnage explained as volume. Length converted 285.24 m = 936 ft. No claim about Fair Havens' location beyond 'Souda isn't Fair Havens'.

preship_review.B_internal_consistency: Embassy numbers, HAL lines, 112/155, advisories and the $126/$140 math match across long form, condensed and handoff card.
preship_review.D_register: Turkey Level 2 stated with the State Department's own do-not-travel area; Medicare gap stated plainly; no alarm language.
preship_review.E_time_sensitivity: Prices, policies and advisories dated November 2026; the refit window disclosed with its primary source.
preship_review.F_variants: Condensed and handoff card carry the same numbers.
